rca_of_the_issue: Original failure was caused by popup.js using the raw string mycareercopilot.ca as a fetch base, which is not an absolute URL. The fix normalizes input by stripping trailing slash or /api, prepending https:// when missing, validating with new URL(), reflecting the normalized origin into the input, and showing hostname-specific network errors. Regression evidence confirms the exact bare-domain flow no longer shows the old generic connection error.
